source: Catamount 2024-25 printed trail map (skimap.org map 33104), checked against the 2025-26 map (map 37806), read by hand
note: Race Slope was renamed Toni Matt on the 2024-25 map. Kelli's Run shows no rating symbol and keeps its OpenStreetMap rating. Panther Park (a terrain park) was removed on the 2025-26 map but is still in OpenStreetMap. The Birch Glades (East and West) on the 2025-26 map are not in OpenStreetMap yet. Terrain on the New York side comes from the NY Hudson 2022 survey.
